# Goal
Kama round15 only. C1 calibration (lowest7 vs operability8): repair the real outside R1 duplicate-corpus guard bug in .ufo/waves/round-14/measure.py, prove >=16-unique duplicate corpora rejected before ANY child process, retain valid unique corpus measurement. Numeric7 stays7; executable fail-closed repair, not runtime restoration. R2 append partial-output clarification. L1 canonical planner.
# Contract
Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. All item paths absolute under this root. Write only assigned file and own report; NEVER edit old receipts/lessons or fleet/sibling files. No commits, tests/builds/linters/formatters/smoke runs: L1 verifies once after edits. Leaf; no delegation/background jobs. Send concerns only agent://KamaR15, never orchestrator/all. No ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files; never history/session access or separate omp CLI. No service restart or host mutation.
Tooling authorization: may install/upgrade helpful tools only after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; record tool/version/channel/reason. Pacman guard: before any install dry-run pacman -Sp --print-format '%n %v' <pkgs>; proceed only if every listed package is not installed (pacman -Q fails); no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade or host-service restart. Prefer no installs here.
Shared fixture schema for tests/ollama-corpus-guard/*.json: array of objects {name: unique descriptive test id, names: array of literal case-name strings, envelope: 'array' or 'object', expected_rejected: bool}. Guard canonicalizes names with strip as existing runner. Harness clones original cases.json first known passing case, replaces name for each names item; every fixture identical except case names/envelope. Invalid duplicate controls must have >=16 distinct stripped names (so old minimum guard cannot catch them); valid controls >=16 names all distinct. Before source snapshot frozen/measure-before.py; final runner stays at existing historical path, old receipt immutable.
